description: Broad Phase 2D search for 1h ATR-normalized anchor-stack width candidates while preserving EMA200 bounce semantics. Main rail is 2.15; 2.35 is comparator; 2.45 is a small transition tail only.
notes: This is broad candidate discovery in 1h ATR width coordinates, not a strict coordinate-mapping diagnostic.
Phase 2B base-width core remains the balanced reference: base 2.15 w11/r12 lb20/lb10.
Phase 2C found a strong 1h branch around w2.5/r2.75/lb35, but it was short-dominant.
Main rail is 2.15 because 2.35/2.45 can drift into higher-order trend capture.
No RSI blocker, ADX, BE/lock, runtime exits, partial TP, trailing, HTF context, or asymmetric rails.

do_not_select_as_main_if: result is carried by only one side
PnL improves only by widening rail and worsening semantic drift
